name: Ну-C Runtz | Rolled Ready
description:
Meet Rolled Ready — perfectly rolled, no prep required. Each pack includes three expertly rolled joints, made exclusively with top-shelf HYMAN flower.

No trim. No shake. No shortcuts — just clean, flavorful flower rolled to burn evenly every time.

Whether you’re enjoying one solo or sharing the moment, Rolled Ready’s deliver smooth hits in a convenient, grab-and-go format. Carefully prepared and sealed for freshness, they’re ready whenever the vibe is.

Grab. Light Enjoy.

Strain Type: Sativa

Aromas: Earthy, Herbal, Sour, Sweet, Tropical

Flavors: Fruity, Pineapple, Sweet, Tropical

Effects: Calming, Relaxing, Sleepy, Uplifting
